data.name: World RTA
data.rules:
- Complete every level in the world in a single segment
- This includes mystery houses, captain toad, and letter levels
- You may use a pre-existing save file
- You may complete the levels in any order
- For 100% runs, you must get all stars, stamps, and golden flagpoles
- Stamp houses are not required as they disappear upon completion
- Time starts upon entry of the first level
- Time ends when the score appears on the flagpole of the last level
- If you have a catsuit on when touching the last pole, you must wait till you grab the pole and the score appears
- Using multiple controllers is NOT allowed except in 100% runs

data.name: World 1
data.rules:
- Complete the level
- You may use a pre-existing save file
- You may use the practice ROM
- For 100% runs, you must get all stars, stamp, and golden flagpole
- Runs are timed using the in-game timer
- You may pause the game
- Using multiple controllers is NOT allowed except in 100% runs

Please insert the time in the In-Game Time field and leave the regular Time blank.
